specs.name: longestGoodSubarray_empty
specs.stmt: theorem longestGoodSubarray_empty : ∀ (k : Nat) (h_precond : longestGoodSubarray_precond [] k), longestGoodSubarray [] k h_precond = 0

specs.name: longestGoodSubarray_singleton
specs.stmt: ∀ (x : Nat) (k : Nat) (h_precond : longestGoodSubarray_precond [x] k), longestGoodSubarray [x] k h_precond = 1

specs.name: longestGoodSubarray_le_length
specs.stmt: theorem longestGoodSubarray_le_length : ∀ (nums : List Nat) (k : Nat) (h_precond : longestGoodSubarray_precond nums k), longestGoodSubarray nums k h_precond ≤ nums.length

specs.name: longestGoodSubarray_nonneg
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Nat) (k : Nat) (h_precond : longestGoodSubarray_precond nums k),
    0 ≤ longestGoodSubarray nums k h_precond

specs.name: longestGoodSubarray_mono_k
specs.stmt: ∀ (nums : List Nat) (k1 k2 : Nat) (h1 : longestGoodSubarray_precond nums k1) (h2 : longestGoodSubarray_precond nums k2), k1 ≤ k2 → longestGoodSubarray nums k1 h1 ≤ longestGoodSubarray nums k2 h2

specs.name: longestGoodSubarray_full_when_k_large
specs.stmt: theorem longestGoodSubarray_full_when_k_large : ∀ (nums : List Nat) (k : Nat) (h_precond : longestGoodSubarray_precond nums k), (∀ x, nums.count x ≤ k) → longestGoodSubarray nums k h_precond = nums.length

specs.name: longestGoodSubarray_pos_of_nonempty
specs.stmt: theorem longestGoodSubarray_pos_of_nonempty : ∀ (nums : List Nat) (k : Nat) (h_precond : longestGoodSubarray_precond nums k), nums ≠ [] → longestGoodSubarray nums k h_precond ≥ 1

specs.name: longestGoodSubarray_postcond_holds
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Nat) (k : Nat)
    (h_precond : longestGoodSubarray_precond nums k),
    let result := longestGoodSubarray nums k h_precond
    let subArrays := List.range (nums.length + 1) |>.flatMap (fun start =>
      List.range (nums.length - start + 1) |>.map (fun len =>
        nums.drop start |>.take len))
    let subArrayFreqs := subArrays.map (fun arr => arr.map (fun x => arr.count x))
    let validSubArrays := subArrayFreqs.filter (fun arr => arr.all (fun x => x ≤ k))
    validSubArrays.all (fun arr => arr.length ≤ result)

specs.name: longestGoodSubarray_k1_le_nodup
specs.stmt: theorem longestGoodSubarray_k1_le_nodup : ∀ (nums : List Nat) (k : Nat) (h_precond : longestGoodSubarray_precond nums k), k = 1 → longestGoodSubarray nums k h_precond ≤ nums.length

specs.name: longestGoodSubarray_le_length_strong
specs.stmt: theorem longestGoodSubarray_le_length_strong : ∀ (nums : List Nat) (k : Nat) (h_precond : longestGoodSubarray_precond nums k), longestGoodSubarray nums k h_precond ≤ nums.toArray.size

specs.name: longestGoodSubarray_meets_postcond
specs.stmt: theorem longestGoodSubarray_meets_postcond : ∀ (nums : List Nat) (k : Nat) (h : longestGoodSubarray_precond nums k), longestGoodSubarray_postcond nums k (longestGoodSubarray nums k h) h

specs.name: longestGoodSubarray_eq_k
specs.stmt: theorem longestGoodSubarray_eq_k (nums : List Nat) (k : Nat) (h_precond : longestGoodSubarray_precond nums k) : longestGoodSubarray_postcond nums k (longestGoodSubarray nums k h_precond) h_precond

specs.name: longestGoodSubarray_pos
specs.stmt: List Nat) (k : Nat) (h_precond : longestGoodSubarray_precond nums k) : longestGoodSubarray nums k h_precond > 0

specs.name: longestGoodSubarray_le_length
specs.stmt: List Nat) (k : Nat) (h : longestGoodSubarray_precond arr k) : longestGoodSubarray arr k h ≤ arr.length

specs.name: longestGoodSubarray_bounded_by_k
specs.stmt: List Nat) (k : Nat) (h_precond : longestGoodSubarray_precond nums k) : longestGoodSubarray nums k h_precond ≤ k
